newsitem.title: CHINA: China police seize 500 kg of "ice", arrest 14.
newsitem.headline: China police seize 500 kg of "ice", arrest 14.

text.p: Police in China's southern boomtown of Guangzhou have seized 500 kg (1,100 lb) of the drug "ice" and arrested 14 people in one of the city's biggest drug busts, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

The ring leader, Xu Yongchang, was arrested in Guangzhou on April 15, it said, adding that Fan Ketong, a lecturer at a medical college, came up with the formula to make methamphetamine hydrochloride, more commonly known as "ice".
A Hong Kong couple was apprehended in Shenzhen bordering the British colony on April 6, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
Police have also seized 30 million yuan ($3.6 million) in drug money since last December and raided nine hideouts which manufactured the drug, Xinhua said.
Drugs had virtually been eradicated in the years after the communists came to power in 1949, but have staged a comeback along with economic reforms in the past two decades.
